slide1.body: Indawo yakho. Umphakathi wakho. Ikusasa lakho. 'Abagcini Bekusasa' bangabantu abavamile abazibonakalisa ezindaweni abazibiza ngokuthi ikhaya — futhi bathole abanye abenza okufanayo.

slide2.body: Abagcini bakha amaqembu amancane asendaweni abizwa ngokuthi amaNdinganiso — futhi basebenzisana ukuze bashintshe izinto ezibalulekile lapho behlala khona. Izinguquko konke okuseduze nabo abangakubona, bakuzwe futhi bakujabulele.

slide3.body: Lokho esikwenzayo kubalulekile. Lokho esikwenza ndawonye kubaluleke nakakhulu. Yonke imisebenzi eqoshiwe yenza umthelela oxhumene nabanye ubonakale. Lokho okubukeka njengechaphaza kungenzeka, empeleni, kube ulwandle.
